name: Basalt
card: A smaller Roaring Fork town where two rivers meet, between Carbondale and Aspen.
near: The town straddles Eagle and Pitkin counties.
metaTitle: Basalt Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Basalt, Colorado. A smaller market that still needs a clear site and a correct Google listing.
body:
Basalt is a small town split across Eagle and Pitkin counties, upstream of Carbondale and downstream of Aspen. Search volume is modest. That makes a sloppy listing more expensive, because there are fewer chances to be the obvious choice.

The work here is clarity: what you do, which side of the valley you cover, and a Google profile that matches the door.
businesses: Home services for Basalt and El Jebel
extraQ: Is a full website worth it in a town this size?
extraA: If the listing is doing all the work and the questions are simple, maybe a smaller site is enough. The $1,000 build is aimed at that kind of local company. I will say so on the call if a larger site would be a waste.
